items.title: Nvidia stock steady as Jensen Huang reportedly weighs CEO comeback, Musk backs return
items.summary: Jensen Huang is reportedly weighing a comeback as supporters in Silicon Valley lobby for his return.

items.title: 'Massive shoes to fill': Wall Street sours on Nvidia stock after Jensen Huang's exit
items.summary: As the market digested the unfolding drama at Nvidia, at least 10 analysts downgraded their Buy rating on the stock to Hold.

items.title: Jensen Huang leaves Nvidia with a $132 billion stake — here's when he can sell and why investors may not know when he does: Chart of the Day
items.summary: Most of Huang's Nvidia shares are tied up with his wife, but the rules on who sees him sell are about to loosen.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Techs Fall As Jensen Huang Mulls Nvidia Return; Anthropic IPO Looms
items.summary: Nvidia earnings are due as Jensen Huang reportedly mulls a return. The Anthropic IPO is ahead.

items.title: Anthropic IPO Reportedly Oversubscribed 7 Times – But Will The AI Euphoria Survive The Stock Market Debut?
items.summary: Some analysts and retail traders expect a pop at the listing, with downside ahead in the near term.

items.title: Steve Jobs Went Back to Apple in 1997 and $10,000 Became $18.6 Million. Jensen Huang May Be Next
items.summary: Jensen Huang has discussed returning to Nvidia, the Financial Times reported Sunday. Five leaders came back before him. When Steve Jobs went back to Apple in 1997, $10,000 became $18.6 million; when Bob Iger went back to Disney, it trailed the S&P 500.

items.title: KOSPI Falls Near 3% as Friday's Nvidia Selloff Reaches Seoul
items.summary: KOSPI falls 2.5% at midday as foreigners sell 852 billion won, carrying Friday's Nvidia-led Wall Street slide into Seoul.

items.title: Jensen Huang Reportedly Considers Returning To Nvidia: FT
items.summary: Jensen Huang reportedly is mulling a return to the chip giant he founded, days after resigning as Nvidia CEO in scandal. Nvidia stock was indicated little changed.
